title: Jericho Boat Charters
specs: Classic 1956 wooden picnic boat built by Raymond Bunker and Ralph Ellis
Scenic cruises around Mount Desert Island, offshore islands, and Acadia National Park
Wildlife viewing including porpoises, seals, and birds
